item.title: 50 ChatGPT "commands" for learning faster from books, articles and lectures
item.description: Most people use ChatGPT for reading the same way. Paste an article, type “summarize this”, get back a wall of text that’s about 70% as long as the original. Then you don’t read that either. A while ago I came across a list of short “commands” that change what the answer looks like. Instead of “summarize”, you write /flashcards or /argumentmap or /actionplan, and the output comes back in a format you can actually use.
